verdict.rationale: Brex's official MCP server lets AI assistants manage expenses, look up users, check cards, review banking transactions and track bills through natural language. Brex also markets an AI-powered expense assistant. However, natural-language operation runs mainly through external AI assistant clients, and the native assistant is shown only for expenses, so coverage of operating the whole product is unproven. missing for 10: a documented first-party natural-language interface across all product areas (e.g., payments, budgets, accounting), detailed docs on supported commands, actions and limits, and independent hands-on corroboration that natural-language operation works reliably.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: The Brex MCP server lets AI assistants interact directly with your Brex account: manage expenses, look up users, check cards, review banking transactions, track bills, and more through natural language.
official MCP server documented at https://developer.brex.com/docs/mcp
